title: The file of an app of the IDE, ~/.air/apps/<id>.yaml
description: The static part of one app: what the IDE registers before the process of the app starts. The registry of air-apps reads the YAML file as JSON and checks it with this schema. A reader ignores a key that it does not know, so the schema allows additional properties. A file whose format has another major is refused with the reason unsupportedFormat.

format.description: The major of the file format. This schema is format 1.

id.description: The id of the app. It equals the name of the file without .yaml. The ids of the tool windows and the actions, and the origin <id>.air-genui-app.local of the frames, come from it.

name.description: The name that the IDE shows: the consent banner, the tool window stripe and the notifications.

icon.description: An SVG icon of 16 px. A relative path resolves from the directory of the file. A file <name>_dark.svg beside it is the icon of a dark theme.

views.description: The views of the app by their id. An app opens instances only of the declared views.

actions.description: The IDE actions of the app. The ids are unique in the file.

ByOs.description: One string for every OS, or one string for each OS. An OS without a value has no app.

Server.description: The process of the app, one for each project of the IDE. Its stdin and stdout are the app link.

command.description: An absolute path of an executable. A relative path resolves from the directory of the file.

args.description: The arguments, one list for every OS, or one list for each OS.

env.description: The variables that the process gets beside the environment of the IDE.

start.description: onFirstView starts the process when the first view of the app opens. onProjectOpen starts it when a project opens, and only after Always Allow.

require.description: What a project must have for the app. git: a Git root in the project. A project that is not on this machine, such as a WSL or a Docker project, is always refused.

resource.description: The ui:// resource of the page of the view. Its host part is the id of the app.

instances.description: one: the IDE keeps at most one instance of the view in a project. many: an instance for each key. A toolWindow and a toolWindowTab are always one.

titleActions.description: The ids of actions of the file that the title of the tool window shows, in this order. Each runs with the instance of the tool window. The registry drops an id that names no action of the file, with one warn log entry.

of.description: The id of a view of the place toolWindow.

Size.description: The size of a new frame in px. A window keeps the bounds that the user gave it.

icon.description: The icon of the action, which a title of a tool window shows: an SVG of 16 px as the icon of the app, or an icon of the IDE by its field path, such as AllIcons.Actions.Refresh.

groups.description: The ids of the IDE action groups that get the action, such as Vcs.MainMenu.

shortcut.description: A KeyStroke of the IDE, for macOS and for the other OS. The user can change it in the Keymap.

Run.description: What an action or the action of a notification does: a call of a tool of the app with the origin action, or the open of a view. The tool may be one that only the app sees (visibility app).

tools.description: none: no agent sees a tool of the app. model: after its own consent, the agents of a session see the tools that the model may call through air_app.
